Name: Valley Upgrades
Author: Endwyr
Description:
== Additions ==
~Clears out the Community Garden east of Town, and allows planting.
~Adds a ton of paved roads around Pelican Town.
~Cleans up Jodi & Haley/Emily's home exteriors, and adds a small planting area behind Haley/Emily's house.
~Pierre has a small garden next to his shop.

== Notes ==
~This mod allows planting throughout Pelican Town (only the Town map). It is recommended to only plant within the specified areas, but it's your game, do what you want!
~Haley and Emily are happy to let you plant in their yard. Pierre, however, doesn't like sharing his land or the secrets of how he grows every plant every season.

== FAQ ==
Why are there 2 files?
One adds ONLY Pierre's garden, the other adds everything else.

1.6?
Fully compatible!

== Compatibility ==
Not widely tested. Probably not compatible with most mods that change Pelican Town. 

NOT SVE compatible, and probably never will be.

== Why this Mod ==
I originally played Stardew Valley on my Switch and have logged 100's of hours on my save. Several NPCs talk about a Community Garden, but I've always wanted to plant in one to help out the town a bit. I assumed the fenced in forest next to Clint's was this garden, so I wanted to plant stuff in it. Additionally, I like adding pathing around town, and it bothered me that the craftable paths, of the same style as the roads in town, don't line up correctly. So I fixed that by paving them in. Then I decided to add other minor additions to the town, for example making Emily & Haley's house have the same lot size as Jodi & Kent. I also wanted Pierre to have a source for the seeds that he sells, so I gave him a mini garden.
